question.problem:
Which of the following integers belong to the residue class $[9]_{13}?$

- $4$
- $-17$
- $35$
question.worked_solution:
The residue class $[9]_{13}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $9$ modulo $13.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[9]_{13} & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡9\,(\text{mod}\,13)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x=9+13k,\,k\in Z} \\  & ={9+13k\,|\,k\in Z} \\  & ={…,\,9-2\cdot 13,\,9-13,\,9,\,9+13,\,9+2\cdot 13,\,…} \\  & ={…,-17,-4,9,22,35,…}.\end{aligned}
$$

We see that $-17$ and $35$ belong to $[9]_{13},$ while $4$ does not.

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only".
